Name: Dry Bus Stop
Author: scrotorrr
Description: Poor Pam!  Day in and day out she waits outside for me to want a ride to the desert.  Rain, snow, blazing hot sun.....nothing stops this dedicated bus driver.  Give her a break.  Keep her safe from the elements with this mod.

Downloads.Description: Fixed the issue of missing pixels (thanks, LilietBorodina!)

Manifest.Name: Dry Bus Stop
Manifest.Description: Keeps Pam dry at the bus stop if it rains.
